full_judgment: "It is not a case of benefit of doubt going to a defeated candidate feeling aggrieved like the accused in a criminal case. Here, presumption is in favour of the returned candidate whose election shall not be declared a nullity unless the Tribunal "is satisfied" as laid down in rule 49 that the election has been materially affected by some illegal acts or contravention of some rules."
